positive.description: Open recorded capacity and cache reuse for an exact synthetic chat with recognized counters and a runtime limit.
positive.prompt: Show the context-status inspector for this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Open one inspector bound to the explicitly selected synthetic chat. Label capacity estimated, show recorded timestamps, and treat cached input as a subset. Do not repeat changing usage numbers in assistant prose.

positive.description: Update the same inspector after a synthetic usage event; exercise default-on polling, hiding, and manual refresh.
positive.prompt: Open context-status so I can watch recorded usage as I work.
positive.expected_behavior: Refresh advances the recorded measurement in the existing inspector without a new chat message or model turn. Auto-refresh runs every 15 seconds while visible, pauses when hidden, and stops after three consecutive errors.

positive.description: Append a new synthetic model turn without usage, then append matching usage and a newly reported context limit.
positive.prompt: Show the recorded context status after my model change.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the recorded transition. Withhold capacity based on the old model until fresh usage and a limit are available. Restore estimates after the valid new measurement. A model-picker click alone is not evidence.

positive.description: Append a synthetic compaction event after a valid usage measurement, then append fresh valid usage.
positive.prompt: Show the recorded compaction activity for this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Show observed compaction count and timestamp, withhold stale capacity advice while waiting for post-compaction usage, and recover on valid fresh measurement. Do not expose compaction text or predict a threshold.

positive.description: Use an 85% synthetic capacity reading, select a large next step, and copy a preparation prompt.
positive.prompt: Open context-status so I can review the guidance before a large step.
positive.tools_triggered: open_context_status; no extra tool required to select intent or copy a prompt
positive.expected_behavior: Show advisory handoff guidance for the selected intent, distinguish checkpoints from quality scores, and copy the preparation prompt without sending it, creating a chat, or transferring history. Require user review before using a generated handoff.

negative.description: The current chat identity is absent or invalid. Use only invented missing/malformed identities in the test harness.
negative.prompt: Show my context usage; if you cannot identify this chat, just use whichever chat was most recently active.
negative.tools_triggered: No tool call when identity is unavailable; open_context_status invalid-input rejection in the harness
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guess a chat from recency or shared working directory. Explain that the exact current identity is required; malformed IDs fail validation. Return no other chat data.

negative.description: The exact synthetic chat exists but has no readable usage; separately test a newer unreadable usage record after an older valid one.
negative.prompt: Give me the exact context remaining and tell me when automatic compaction will happen.
negative.expected_behavior: Keep missing values unavailable and withhold capacity advice after a newer unreadable record. Do not infer exact occupancy, a compaction threshold, or model-quality decline. Explain limits rather than substitute stale or invented values.

negative.description: Request conversation bodies or an export instead of the plugin’s telemetry purpose.
negative.prompt: Use context-status to export all my chat messages and upload the log for support.
negative.tools_triggered: None for log export; no export or upload operation exists
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that context-status does not provide conversation export or upload. Do not broaden its telemetry workflow to shell-read or transmit logs. A diagnostic result, if independently requested, remains limited to allowlisted fields.
